meta.name: City of God: The Fight Rages On
meta.description: Twenty years after City of God, Buscapé recounts how conflicts between police, traffickers, and militias impacted the community.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Wilson returns to the City of God to reconnect with old friends. Bradock's reappearance in the neighborhood sets off a dangerous conflict.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Wilson meets a reporter looking to investigate police corruption. Barbantinho attempts to set up a face-to-face between Curió and Bradock.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Amid a deadly war for territory, PQD taps into his military background to support Curió, while Jerusa orchestrates an ambush.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Amid chaos brought by Bradock’s erratic behavior, Wilson and Lígia uncover a mysterious connection to a local politician.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: As the military police invade the City of God, Wilson captures damning evidence against Jerusa, and Berenice stands up to Reginaldo.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: While the community rallies around her campaign for City Council, Berenice gets a warning from Bradock. Meanwhile, Wilson and Lígia find themselves in danger as they get closer to exposing the conspiracy between Reginaldo and arms traffickers.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: As violence threatens to erupt in the streets, Wilson becomes obsessed with finding the truth, and Martinha calls on an old acquaintance.
